issue.title: test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot times out on the 15s _pin_axe_output_top wait under the parallel visual lane, passes in isolation

task_type_fields.evidence:
PROPOSED BY: closed phase bead sase-tj.10.3 (note #2, 2026-08-25T23:02:04Z) of epic
sase-tj.10; routed here by that epic's land agent. Not caused by sase-tj.10, which
touched no AXE code: its diff is the Artifacts Agent pane, the fast-startup sub-tab
inventory, and the artifacts_* PNG goldens.

FAILURE MODE (this is NOT a pixel mismatch): the node times out inside
_pin_axe_output_top (tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py:47) on
wait_for_state(..., description="AXE output scroll pinned to top", timeout=15.0),
raising before any PNG is captured. Recorded call duration in the red run was 16.23s
against a 15s budget.

FAIL/PASS OBSERVATIONS on master e8de34fe0 (clean tree, workspace sase_15,
2026-08-26):
  - `just test-visual -q` run 1: RED. 7 failed, 803 passed, 1 skipped in 204.49s.
    This node failed with the timeout above (the other 6 failures were the
    sase-tj.10.3 Agent-pane goldens, a separate deterministic defect fixed in that
    epic's landing).
  - `just test-visual -q -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py`
    (2 nodes, no lane contention): GREEN, call duration 2.22s -- 7x under the wait
    budget.
  - `just test-visual -q` run 2 (same tree, after the Agent-pane fix): GREEN.
    810 passed, 1 skipped in 192.34s. So the node passed and failed on an unchanged
    tree.
  Fail rate: 1 of 2 full parallel visual lanes; 0 of 2 isolated runs.

SERIAL VS PARALLEL: only reproduced under `just test-visual`'s parallel xdist lane.
Never reproduced when the file is run alone. The 7x call-duration spread between the
two conditions is the signal: the 15s ceiling is sized for an unloaded host, and the
scroll-pin predicate does not converge within it when the lane is saturated.

RELATED, NOT DUPLICATE: sase-ol owns the same node but a different defect -- an
unconverged AXE summary block producing a deterministic 23145/586500-pixel mismatch.
It is CLOSED, fixed by 72f93fb1f, and that fix is what introduced
_pin_axe_output_top(). This report is about that new wait timing out, not about the
summary block, and the failure never reaches pixel comparison. sase-r5 lists this node
in its 36-golden rebaseline backlog; do not rebaseline it -- there is no golden drift
here.

payload.description: Same node, adjacent defect: sase-ol is the CLOSED pixel-mismatch flake whose fix (72f93fb1f) added the _pin_axe_output_top() wait that this bead reports timing out. Read its close note before touching the settle path.
